name: process mode
definition: Kind of ALD process by co-reactant activation: thermal, ozone-based or plasma-enhanced (Cremers 2019, Sec. IV: three types of ALD processes).

name: material
definition: The material being deposited; value is a species id.

name: reactant A
definition: The first reactant of the ALD cycle, which reacts in a self-terminating way with the surface in step 1 (Cremers 2019, Sec. I; Popov 2025, Table I 'Reactant A'); value is a species id.

name: reactant B
definition: The second reactant of the ALD cycle, which reacts in a self-terminating way with the adsorbed species in step 3 (Cremers 2019, Sec. I; Popov 2025, Table I 'Reactant B'); value is a species id.

name: carrier gas
definition: The inert gas in which the reactants are entrained and which purges the reactor between reactant pulses (Cremers 2019, Sec. II C; Popov 2025, Sec. I); value is a species id.

name: reactor
definition: Name and manufacturer of the reactor, as one string.

name: delivery method
definition: Method of delivering the precursor and co-reactant to the reaction chamber.

name: crystallinity
definition: Whether the film is amorphous or crystalline.

name: reactor
definition: Reactor class by working pressure regime: pump-type, flow-type or atmospheric-pressure (Cremers 2019, Sec. II C, Fig. 3).

name: plasma configuration
definition: Plasma configuration of a PE-ALD process: capacitive, inductive, remote or radical enhanced (Cremers 2019, Table IV).

name: structure
definition: The test structure or substrate on which conformality is quantified (Cremers 2019, Sec. III, Table I 'Structure'; Tables II-IV 'Substrate'); value is a structure id.

name: temperature
definition: The substrate/reactor temperature during film growth: the deposition temperature T of Cremers 2019 (Eq. 3; Table II column 'T').
aliases: Deposition temperature; substrate temperature; Temperature (°C); T (°C); Temperature (K)

name: pressure
definition: The total pressure within the reactor during deposition.
aliases: process pressure; Chamber pressure; Pressure (mbar); total pressure; gas pressure

name: growth per cycle
definition: The amount of material deposited on the surface after each ALD cycle, here expressed as thickness per cycle (Cremers 2019, Sec. I).
aliases: GrowthPerCycle; growth per cycle; GPC; Thickness/cycles S/N (nm); SI/N (GPCI); SIIb/N (GPCIIb); Film growth per cycle

name: nucleation period
definition: Number of initial ALD cycles before steady growth, measured in cycles.

name: pulse
definition: Duration of a reactant exposure step (steps 1 and 3 of the ALD cycle, Cremers 2019, Sec. I); the exposure is the product of reactant partial pressure and pulse time (Cremers Sec. II D). For a plasma step it is the plasma-on time.
aliases: DosingTime; pulse time; Pulse length (s); Length of the reactant pulse; TMA pulse; plasma pulse length; pulse length; t_1

name: purge
definition: Duration of the step in which excess reactant and gaseous by-products are purged or pumped away (steps 2 and 4 of the ALD cycle, Cremers 2019, Sec. I).
aliases: PurgeTime; purge time; Purge; pump time

name: refractive index
definition: Refractive index of the film.

name: absorption coefficient
definition: Optical absorption coefficient of the film: attenuation of light intensity per unit length.

name: resistivity
definition: Electrical resistivity of the film.

name: carrier concentration
definition: Number of charge carriers per unit volume of the film.

name: carrier mobility
definition: Carrier mobility in the film.

name: nonuniformity
definition: Relative variation of film thickness between positions along a planar substrate; a uniform film has equal thickness at each position along a planar substrate (Cremers 2019, Sec. II A).

name: aspect ratio
definition: Aspect ratio of the structure, AR = L/w, with L the depth and w the width of the structure (Cremers 2019, Sec. II G, Eq. 11).
aliases: AspectRatio; aspect ratio; Max. AR; structural aspect ratio; L/d

name: coated aspect ratio
definition: The (equivalent) aspect ratio reached by the coating: equal to that of the structure for complete coverage, otherwise calculated from PD50% (Cremers 2019, Sec. II H; Tables II-IV).

name: composition
definition: Atomic fraction of an element in the deposited film.

name: film density
definition: Mass density of the film.
aliases: FilmDensity; film density; Density of the condensed phase; rho

name: partial pressure
definition: Partial pressure of a gas species; the reactant partial pressure multiplied by the pulse time gives the exposure (Cremers 2019, Sec. II D; P_i in Eq. 3).
aliases: Partial pressure of reactant A; Input partial pressure of reactant A; Pressure pA (Pa); pA0 (Pa); pO (mbar); Partial pressure of active species; p_A0; p_i; vapour pressure

name: exposure
definition: The product of the reactant partial pressure and the pulse time (Cremers 2019, Sec. II D).

name: source temperature
definition: Temperature at which the precursor source (bubbler, canister) is held (Popov 2025, Sec. IV).

name: thickness
definition: Thickness of the deposited film at a position; as a function of depth into the structure it is the thickness profile (Cremers 2019, Sec. II H, Fig. 7).
aliases: Film thickness (nm); Film thickness S (nm); Thickness (nm); film thickness; Thickness outside SI (nm); Initial thickness SIIb (nm); interface layer thickness; onset of steady growth

name: penetration depth
definition: The depth at which the film thickness equals a given fraction of the film thickness at the top: 50% for PD50%, 80% for PD80% (Cremers 2019, Sec. II H, Fig. 7b).
aliases: PD50%; x50% (PD50%); Penetration depth xp (µm); Half-thickness penetration depth; 50% thickness penetration depth; x_50% (PD^50%)

name: equivalent aspect ratio
definition: The aspect ratio of a hypothetical cylindrical hole that would require the same reactant exposure dose as the feature of interest (Cremers 2019, Sec. II G). Recorded as reported, never computed.

name: step coverage
definition: The ratio of the film thickness at the bottom of a feature (or at the side wall) to the film thickness at the top of the feature (Cremers 2019, Sec. II H, Fig. 7a).

name: initial sticking coefficient
definition: The reaction probability of a reactant molecule with a bare surface, s0 in s = s0(1 - θ) (Cremers 2019, Sec. II E, Eq. 5).
aliases: initial sticking coefficient; lumped sticking coefficient; cTMA; cH2O; sticking coefficient; c; c_ext

name: recombination probability
definition: The probability that a species recombines during a collision with the surface (Cremers 2019, Sec. II E; Table VII).

name: surface coverage
definition: The fraction of covered surface sites, θ (Cremers 2019, Sec. II E, Eqs. 5-9).
aliases: Surface coverage (θ); Surface coverage; fraction of covered sites

name: feature width
definition: The width w of the structure, the smallest dimension of its opening (Cremers 2019, Sec. II G, Fig. 5): channel height of a lateral structure, width of a trench, diameter of a hole.
aliases: Design channel height H (nm); Channel height (nm); Height of the channel; H (nm); LHAR H (µm); opening height; channel gap height; minor axis; h; pore diameter (nm); targeted channel height H; Design channel height H; LHAR H; d_pore; channel height; H (channel height)
note: For a lateral channel the gap H is the width (feature_width), the length along the channel is the depth (feature_depth), the channel width W across it is the extent (feature_extent).

name: feature depth
definition: The depth L of the structure, measured from its entrance along the direction of reactant diffusion (Cremers 2019, Sec. II G, Fig. 5): channel length of a lateral structure.
aliases: L (mm); Length of the channel; Lateral length of the channel (mm); channel length L; lateral length L; l/2; cavity length; channel length; L (channel length)
note: For a lateral channel the gap H is the width (feature_width), the length along the channel is the depth (feature_depth), the channel width W across it is the extent (feature_extent).

name: feature extent
definition: The length z of the feature along the third dimension, perpendicular to w and L (Cremers 2019, Sec. II G, Fig. 6): channel width of a lateral structure, trench length of a vertical trench.
aliases: Width of the channel; channel width W; major axis; channel width; W (channel width)
note: For a lateral channel the gap H is the width (feature_width), the length along the channel is the depth (feature_depth), the channel width W across it is the extent (feature_extent).

name: cycles
definition: Number of ALD cycles applied in a deposition.
aliases: ALD cycles N; Number of cycles; Cycles; number of ALD cycles; ALD cycles

name: plasma power
definition: Power delivered to the plasma source during the plasma step (the RF power of Cremers 2019, Sec. IV C).

name: gas flow
definition: Flow rate of a gas into the reactor.

name: normalized thickness
definition: Film thickness divided by a reference thickness: the thickness at the feature entrance, on the planar surface, or an assumed saturated thickness.
aliases: Normalized thickness (-); Normalized deposition thickness; Type 1 normalized saturation profile; normalized thickness

name: adsorption equilibrium constant
definition: Equilibrium constant K of reversible Langmuir adsorption, the ratio of the adsorption and desorption rate constants per unit pressure (Ylilammi 2018, Eq. 13).
aliases: Adsorption equilibrium constant; K (Pa-1); Adsorption equilibrium constant (1/Pa)

name: saturation growth per cycle
definition: The equilibrium thickness of layer growth in one cycle at saturation, i.e. at high reactant exposure (Ylilammi 2018, Eq. 46); a model parameter, distinct from the observed growth_per_cycle.
aliases: Saturation growth in cycle; gpcsat (pm); Saturation growth in cycle (nm)

name: distance from the entrance
definition: Position along the direction of reactant diffusion, measured from the feature entrance, positive inward and negative outside the feature.
aliases: Distance inside the channel x (µm); Distance x (µm); Location x (µm); Location (µm); Depth (m); Distance [µm]; Distance from the beginning of the channel

name: depth over height
definition: Distance from the feature entrance divided by the feature width, x/w (Yim 2020: x̃ = x/H).

name: time in the pulse
definition: Time elapsed since the start of a reactant pulse.

name: purity
definition: Purity of a reagent as supplied, as a percentage (gre23: DEZ min. 95%; mat22: the Mo precursor and the plasma gases).

name: H2 flow ratio
definition: The flow of one feed gas of the plasma step over the summed flows of the reactive feed gases (mat22 Eq. 1: the H2 flow ratio H2/(H2 + H2S)); relative_to all_gases divides by the whole feed including the carrier (a transform).

name: cycle time
definition: The duration of one ALD cycle: the sum of its pulse, hold and purge times.
aliases: cycle time; one full ALD cycle takes

name: substrate
definition: The material of the growth surface, a species id (Cremers 2019 Table VII column 'Surface'; proposal substrate_material accepted in Sec. 18.9); the stack behind it (an oxide on silicon, a foil) stays in the setting's statement.

name: mass gain
definition: Mass gained by a specimen in a deposition, relative to its initial or final mass (the relative_to qualifier), as a percentage.

name: moles deposited per run
definition: Moles of film material deposited in one run, from the deposited moles per cycle times the cycle number (a transform; gre23 mass balance).

name: moles from mass gain
definition: Moles of film material deposited in one run from the gravimetric mass gain and the material's molar mass (a transform; the second route of gre23's mass balance).

name: solid deposited per cycle
definition: Moles of solid deposited per ALD cycle, from the pressure trace of the reactant half-reaction (gre23 Δn_s, Eq. 2).

name: metal atoms per cycle
definition: Metal atoms deposited per unit area per cycle, the amount-based growth per cycle (Cremers 2019 Sec. I allows the GPC as an areal density; proposal mass-based growth per cycle accepted in Sec. 18.9); from the thickness GPC and the film density, or from a pressure trace.
aliases: atoms per cycle; metal atoms per cycle; Mo atoms deposited per cycle

name: coating mass fraction
definition: The coating's share of the coated specimen's mass: mass gain / (1 + mass gain) with the gain relative to the initial mass (a transform; not a phase fraction).

name: coating volume fraction
definition: The coating's share of a porous compact's volume for spherical particles of the stated diameter and coating thickness (a transform).

name: thickness per hour
definition: Film thickness grown per hour: the growth per cycle over the cycle time (a transform).

name: gas released per cycle
definition: Moles of gas released per ALD cycle in a half-reaction, from the pressure rise in a closed chamber (gre23 Δn_g, Eq. 1).

name: gas-to-solid ratio
definition: Moles of gas released per mole of solid deposited in a half-reaction: the gas-to-solid ratio ȳ of gre23 (x ligands released per precursor).
aliases: ȳ; gas-to-solid ratio; x; ȳ (printed ν̄ in the text layer)

name: pressure rise
definition: The rise of chamber pressure during a reactant hold in a closed chamber, δp of gre23; with level maximum its peak value.
aliases: δp; pressure rise; δp_max; δp maximum

name: terminal pressure slope
definition: The slope of the chamber pressure at the end of a reactant hold, the terminal slope TS of gre23: positive for gas-producing processes, negative when leaks dominate.
aliases: TS; terminal slope; terminal pressure slope

name: time to pressure maximum
definition: The time from the start of a reactant hold to the pressure maximum, t_max of gre23.
aliases: t_max; time to pressure maximum; time to δp maximum

name: porosity
definition: The pore volume fraction of a porous body, before (stage initial) or after (stage final) the deposition, relative to the total volume.
aliases: porosity; φ_i; φ_f; Final porosity, φ_f (%)

name: pore density
definition: The number of pores per unit area of a porous membrane's surface.

name: tortuosity
definition: The ratio of the path length through a porous body's pores to the straight distance, a factor on its effective diffusivity.

name: pore volume
definition: The volume of the open pores of a porous material per unit mass.

name: channel filled
definition: The share of a channel's height filled by the film on its two walls at the end of a run (yim20: 2 S_IIb / H).

name: roughness
definition: Root-mean-square surface roughness of the film from AFM (mat22 Rq).
aliases: Rq; roughness; RMS roughness; root-mean-square roughness

name: binding energy
definition: The binding energy of an XPS core-level component of the film, which names its chemical state.
aliases: BE; binding energy; Mo 3d5/2 BE; S 2p3/2 BE; BE shift below S2-; Ga 2p3/2; S 2s

name: crystallite size
definition: The coherent crystallite size of a phase from the width of its diffraction peaks (gre23, Rietveld) or from microscopy (mat22).
aliases: crystallite size; grain size; nanocrystallite width; corundum grain size; ZnO (zincite) Crystallite size (nm); Zn (metallic) Crystallite size (nm)

name: sheet resistance
definition: Resistivity over film thickness, the resistance of a square of the film (a transform; mat22 measures it by four-point probe and reports resistivity).

name: density relative to bulk
definition: The film's mass density over the bulk density of the same material, as a percentage (a transform).

name: phase
definition: Whether a named phase (the species qualifier) was detected in the film by the stated method: detected or not detected (P15).

name: anneal temperature
definition: The temperature of a post-deposition anneal (one pilot paper; Sec. 7 keeps it native, so stored as an attribute until a second paper needs it).
aliases: annealing temperature; T_anneal; annealing temperature in air

name: saturation density
definition: Areal density of adsorption sites at saturation, q of the Ylilammi model as used by yim20 (a model internal, Sec. 4; stored as an attribute of the model runs).
aliases: q; saturation density; q_sat; S_Hf; S_O; Γ; σ

name: probe spot
definition: The lateral size of a measurement probe: the reflectometer spot (yim20) or the EDS line width (gre23) (an instrument setting, Sec. 4).

name: objective
definition: The magnification of the reflectometer objective (yim20 ×5, ×10, ×50) (an instrument setting, Sec. 4).

name: pillar layout
definition: The named pillar layout of a PillarHall chip design (yim20 v1a, v1b, v2a) (an equipment detail, Sec. 4).

name: Raman shift
definition: The abscissa of a Raman spectrum (a signal axis, Sec. 4).

name: Knudsen number
definition: The mean free path of the reactant over the characteristic size of the feature (the channel height, the pore or particle diameter): Kn >> 1 is Knudsen (free-molecular) flow (Cremers 2019 Sec. V C; yim20 Sec. D). Promoted from 'derived dimensionless groups' (Sec. 4) by decision D2.

name: mean free path
definition: The mean free path of a reactant molecule in the gas at the deposition temperature and its partial pressure, k_B T / (sqrt(2) pi d^2 p) (yim20 Sec. D). Promoted from 'molecule properties' (Sec. 4) by decision D2.

name: front slope
definition: The slope of a saturation profile at its half-thickness point, as thickness per cycle or as normalized thickness per unit of dimensionless distance (yim20 Table 1); an attribute of a profile, stored as data, not a concept (Sec. 18.7).
aliases: Slope dθ/dx̃; Slope d(S/N)/dx̃; front slope

name: fit R²
definition: The coefficient of determination of a fit (yim20 Table 1, the linear fit of the front); fit quality, an attribute of a value, not a concept (Sec. 18.7).
aliases: R2; R²; Linear fitting residual R2; Linear fitting residual R^2

name: signal
definition: A detector signal against position or energy (an EDS, Raman, XPS or X-ray count or an arbitrary-unit intensity); a signal without a quantity (Sec. 4), stored as the trace it is, not a concept (Sec. 18.7).
aliases: Intensity; a.u.; counts; Intensity (Arb. units); Intensity (Normalized to Si); Intensity [a.u.]; Normalized X-ray counts (Zn)

name: element fraction
definition: The atomic fraction of an element among all atoms of the film counted by the stated method, in at.% (the former composition entry, Sec. 18.3).
aliases: at.%; at. %; atomic percent; H content; O content; N content; C content; H (at. %); C (at. %); N (at. %); O (at. %); C after sputtering; O after sputtering

name: element ratio
definition: Atoms of an element per atom of a reference element in the film, as the stated method sees it (mat22's S/Mo stoichiometry x in MoSx; H per metal atom), a unitless ratio (Sec. 18.3; absorbs h_per_metal).
aliases: S/Mo; S/W; S/Mo ratio; stoichiometry; S/Mo ratio (RBS); S/Mo ratio (XPS); XPS S/Mo ratio

name: phase fraction
definition: The weight fraction of a named phase (the phase qualifier) among the phases the stated method sees, in wt%; by XRD Rietveld refinement only the crystalline part is counted (relative_to crystalline_phases), which gre23 does not state (not_stated) (Sec. 18.3).
aliases: wt%; Wt. %; weight percent; ZnO (zincite) Wt. %

name: H per metal atom
definition: Hydrogen atoms per metal atom of the film, computed from the H at.% and the S/Mo ratio (the pilot's derived quantity); absorbed into element_ratio{element=H, reference_element=the metal} (Sec. 18.3).

name: body thickness
definition: The full thickness of a porous body or membrane between its faces; with two entry sides it is twice the diffusion length L, the depth Cremers measures from the entrance (Cremers 2019 Sec. II G; gre23 Sec. II A: the NPC thickness 2L, L half of it since precursor enters through both faces). Slot of the porous_body class; transform body_thickness = feature_depth × entry_sides.
aliases: body thickness; compact thickness; NPC thickness; membrane thickness; film thickness (µm)

name: entry sides
definition: Through how many faces of a porous body the reactant enters: one (a body sealed on one side, a feature closed at the bottom) or two (a free-standing compact or membrane open on both faces); the diffusion length L is the body thickness divided by this count (gre23 Sec. II A: L is half the NPC thickness since precursor enters through both the top and the bottom face; Cremers 2019 Sec. II G: L measured from the entrance along the diffusion). Slot of the porous_body class.
aliases: entry faces; number of entry sides; faces open to the reactant

name: particle diameter
definition: The diameter of the particles of a particle compact or bed; the pores between them have about this size, so it stands in for the pore diameter w (Cremers 2019 Sec. II G: the smallest opening; gre23 Sec. II A: d_NP = 100 nm from the powder's specific surface area). Slot of the porous_body class.
aliases: particle diameter; NP diameter; nanoparticle diameter; d_NP

name: specific surface area
definition: The surface area of a powder or porous body per unit mass, as measured by gas adsorption (BET); with the material density it gives the particle diameter (gre23 Sec. II A: s = 15 m2/g, the maker's BET specification of the BMA15 powder). Slot of the porous_body class.
aliases: specific surface area; BET area; BET specific surface area; surface area per mass

name: body diameter
definition: The lateral size of a porous body perpendicular to the diffusion direction: the diameter of a compact or a die (gre23 Sec. II A: pressed in an 11.4 mm die, final NPC diameter 11.43 mm by calipers). Slot of the porous_body class.
aliases: body diameter; compact diameter; die diameter; NPC diameter; membrane diameter; diameter

name: diffraction angle
definition: The diffraction angle 2θ of an X-ray diffractogram: the abscissa of a diffraction pattern, on which the peaks of a phase are read as printed (P84: a peak coordinate).

name: molar mass
definition: The molar mass M of a reactant molecule (M_A of reactant A, M_B of reactant B), a model input of the diffusion-reaction models and a series variable of their parameter studies.
aliases: M_A; M_B; MA; molar mass; reactant molar mass; molar mass of reactant A

name: molecule diameter
definition: The hard-sphere diameter of a reactant or carrier-gas molecule (d_A, d_B), a model input of the diffusion-reaction models (from the gas viscosity or the condensed-phase density).
aliases: d_B; molecular diameter; diameter of molecule A; d_TMA; d_TiCl4

name: knudsen diffusion coefficient
definition: The Knudsen diffusion coefficient D_Kn of the reactant in a feature or pore: wall collisions alone set it, D_Kn = (d_h/3)(8RT/(πM))^1/2 with the hydraulic diameter d_h and the molar mass M; a model parameter of the diffusion-reaction models, varied through the pressure and the geometry.

name: effective diffusion coefficient
definition: The effective diffusion coefficient D_eff of the reactant in a feature or pore: the Bosanquet interpolation 1/D_eff = 1/D_A + 1/D_Kn of the gas-phase and Knudsen coefficients, in a porous body further scaled by porosity over tortuosity (Heikkinen 2024 D_e); a model parameter of the diffusion-reaction models.
aliases: D_eff; Deff; D_e; De; effective diffusion coefficient

name: gas phase diffusion coefficient
definition: The gas-phase (molecular, bulk) diffusion coefficient D_A of the reactant in the carrier gas, set by intermolecular collisions and so by the total pressure; the continuum limit of the Bosanquet interpolation; a model parameter of the diffusion-reaction models.
aliases: D_mi; Dmi; gas-phase diffusion coefficient; molecular diffusion coefficient

name: reactant number density
definition: The number of reactant molecules per unit gas volume n (n_P0 at the surface of a porous body), the concentration variable of Heikkinen 2024's diffusion-reaction equation; a model output along the depth and a model input at the surface. Converts to the partial pressure by the ideal gas law p = n·k_B·T given the temperature (P109).
aliases: n_P; n_P0; reactant number density; volumetric reactant number density; number density of the reactant

name: metal atoms per film formula unit
definition: b_film is the number of metal atoms in the formula unit of the deposited film

name: reactor wall temperature
definition: temperature at which the reactor or chamber walls are held during deposition, as distinct from the substrate or table temperature

name: measurement wavelength range
definition: wavelength interval covered by an optical measurement (reflectometry, transmittance)

name: reactor base pressure
definition: lowest pressure the pumped reactor reaches with no gas flowing (ultimate vacuum), stated before deposition

name: desorption probability (per unit time)
definition: desorption probability, P_d
